# Testing SNP differentiation using linear models

## Read filtered SNP table and load packages

Also sets the cowplot theme

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())

FF_genomes_filtered <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/FF_genomes_filtered.RDS")

```

## Linear models

### Manual t test calculation

Manually calculate t-test via matrix calculations.

```{r}
SNP_ID <- paste0(FF_genomes_filtered$CHROM, "_", FF_genomes_filtered$POS)

mat_CON <- as.matrix(FF_genomes_filtered[, c("freq_CON1", "freq_CON2", "freq_CON3", "freq_CON4")])
rownames(mat_CON) <- SNP_ID

mat_FP <- as.matrix(FF_genomes_filtered[, c("freq_FP1", "freq_FP2", "freq_FP3", "freq_FP4")])
rownames(mat_FP) <- SNP_ID

# Arcsine squareroot transformation
mat_CON <- asin(sqrt(mat_CON))
mat_FP <- asin(sqrt(mat_FP))

mean_CON <- rowMeans(mat_CON)
mean_FP <- rowMeans(mat_FP)

n_CON <- ncol(mat_CON)
n_FP <- ncol(mat_FP)

var_CON <- (rowSums(mat_CON^2) - (n_CON * (mean_CON^2)))/(n_CON - 1)
var_FP <- (rowSums(mat_FP^2) - (n_FP * (mean_FP^2)))/(n_FP - 1)

sesq_CON <- var_CON/n_CON
sesq_FP <- var_FP/n_FP
se_total <- sqrt(sesq_CON + sesq_FP)

t_stat <- (mean_CON - mean_FP)/se_total

# Welch-Satterthwaite d.o.f. calculation
dof_numer <- (sesq_CON + sesq_FP)^2
dof_denom <- ((sesq_CON^2)/(n_CON-1)) + ((sesq_FP^2)/(n_FP-1))
dof_welch <- dof_numer/dof_denom

p_vals <- pt(abs(t_stat), dof_welch ,lower.tail=FALSE) * 2

test_loop <- 1000
random_indices <- sample(1:nrow(mat_CON), test_loop, replace = FALSE)
t_match <- tibble(indices = random_indices, 
                  manual_ttest = numeric(length = test_loop),
                  R_ttest = numeric(length = test_loop),
                  difference = numeric(length = test_loop))
cc <-  0
for(rr in random_indices){
  cc <-  cc + 1
  t_match$manual_ttest[cc] <- p_vals[rr]
  
  t_try <- t.test(mat_CON[rr, ], mat_FP[rr, ])
  t_match$R_ttest[cc] <- t_try$p.value
  
  t_match$difference[cc] = t_match$manual_ttest[cc] - t_match$R_ttest[cc] 
  
  #stopifnot(p_vals[rr] == t_try$p.value)  
}

# plot -log10 of the difference between 1000 random t tests and manual t test.
boxplot(-log10(abs(t_match$difference) + 0.1^20))

na_indices <- which(!complete.cases(t_match$difference))

boxplot(-log10(p_vals))

adj_pvals <- p.adjust(p_vals, method = 'fdr')

boxplot(-log10(adj_pvals))
```

#### Scanplot for manual t-test p-values

```{r}
FF_ttestres <- p_vals %>% as_tibble(rownames = "SNP_ID") %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(
    cols = SNP_ID,
    delim = "_",
    names = c("Chromosome", "Position"),
  ) %>% rename(P_vals = value) %>% mutate(Position = as.numeric(Position))


# FDR correction on P values
FF_ttestres$adj_pvals <- p.adjust(p_vals, method = "fdr")

# Chromosomal IDs for scanplot
Xaxis_CHROM <- FF_ttestres %>% group_by(Chromosome) %>% 
  summarise(center = (min(Position) + max(Position))/2)

ttest_scanplot <- ggplot(data = FF_ttestres, aes(
x = Position, y = -log10(adj_pvals), size = -log10(adj_pvals))) +
  facet_grid(.~ Chromosome) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Chromosome), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
  values = rep(c("steelblue3", "skyblue"), 
               length(Xaxis_CHROM$Chromosome))) +
  ylim(c(0, 3)) +
  ylab("-log10(FDR adjusted P Value)") +
  xlab("Position") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = 'dotted', color = 'red') +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = 'none')

print(ttest_scanplot)
```

OLD: For each locus, fit the following models:

i\) A linear model with default settings (normal distribution)

ii\) A generalized linear model with quasibinomial distribution

```{r}
FF_matrix_raw <- FF_genomes_filtered[, seq(5,12, by=1)]
FF_depth <- FF_genomes_filtered[, seq(13,20, by=1)]

FF_matrix <- as.matrix(FF_matrix_raw)
FF_depth <- as.matrix(FF_depth)

linear_output <- numeric(length = nrow(FF_matrix))

ttest_output <- numeric(length = nrow(FF_matrix))

quasibinom_output <- numeric(length = nrow(FF_matrix))

perc_tracker <- round(nrow(FF_matrix) * 0.05)

paste0("Progress: START")

for(ii in 1:nrow(FF_matrix)){
  FF_temp <- data.frame(
    "Treatment" = rep(c("CON","FP"), each = 4), 
    "Frequency" = FF_matrix[ii,],
    "Depth" = FF_depth[ii,])
  
  # quasibinomial model
  quasibinom_FFtemp <- glm(data = FF_temp,
  Frequency ~ Treatment, 
  family = "quasibinomial",
  weights = Depth)
  
  quasibinom_output[ii] <- as.double(tidy(quasibinom_FFtemp)[2,5])
  # Arcsine squareroot transform data before fitting linear models
  FF_temp <- FF_temp %>% 
    mutate(Freq_asqrt = asin(sqrt(Frequency)))
  
  # linear model with anova
  mod_FF_temp <- lm(data = FF_temp, 
                    Freq_asqrt ~ Treatment)
  mod_FF_temp <- anova(mod_FF_temp)
  linear_output[ii] <- mod_FF_temp$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  
  # t test
  ttest_FFtemp <- t.test(data = FF_temp, 
                         Freq_asqrt ~ Treatment, var.equal = TRUE)
  ttest_output[ii] <- ttest_FFtemp$p.value
  
  
  
  if (ii %% perc_tracker == 0){
    current_per <- (ii/nrow(FF_matrix) * 100)
    cat("Progress: ", current_per, "%\n")
  }
}

FF_results <- FF_genomes_filtered[, c(1, 2)] %>% 
             mutate(CHROM = fct_drop(CHROM))

FF_results$lm_adjPval <- p.adjust(linear_output, method = "fdr")
FF_results$t_adjPval <- p.adjust(ttest_output, method = "fdr")
FF_results$qb_adjPval <- p.adjust(quasibinom_output, method = "fdr")

```

```{r}
X_CHROM <- FF_results %>% group_by(CHROM) %>% summarise(center = (min(POS) + max(POS))/2)

scanplot <- ggplot(data = FF_results, aes(
x = POS, y = -log10(lm_adjPval), size = -log10(lm_adjPval))) +
  facet_grid(.~ CHROM) +
  geom_point(aes(color = CHROM), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
  values = rep(c("steelblue3", "skyblue"), 
               length(X_CHROM$CHROM))) +
  ylim(c(0, 3)) +
  ylab("-log10(FDR adjusted P Value)") +
  xlab("Position") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = 'dotted', color = 'red') +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = 'none')

print(scanplot)
```
